requirements.text: Bay Area preferred, with ability to work from the office 1–2 days per week - Otherwise, must provide 4–6 hours of daily working overlap with Pacific Time

Roche is seeking a Senior Lead GenAI Engineer to architect and build production-ready generative AI applications for personalized commercial marketing content. The role focuses on multi-agent orchestration, stateful GenAI applications, API-first architecture, and structured content generation. This is a hands-on technical leadership position requiring architecture decisions, coding, and production implementation.
Advanced Python or TypeScript development and microservices experience.
Develop stateful, multi-turn, multi-agent orchestration with conversation history, memory, and clarification flows.
Build API-first, headless services that generate structured JSON or HTML for downstream platforms.
Integrate GenAI applications with enterprise APIs, data services, and content repositories.
Implement RAG, grounding, evaluations, streaming, and production observability.
Experience with streaming GenAI interfaces and multi-turn conversational workflows.
Leverage AWS, Amazon Bedrock, and AgentCore for GenAI application development.
